items.title: M1: Add a host-run choke-point command that launches codex/claude/agy via the B-d8ef canonical launcher argv and writes preflight plus final usage rows bound to storyId, agentType, phase, and provider
items.context: Reuse core/usage-ledger dispatch-usage seam (recordDispatchPreflight, budget guard, recordDispatchFinal/recordDispatchFinalForProvider). Codex: parse stdout turn.completed usage (input_tokens/cached_input_tokens/output_tokens/reasoning_output_tokens). Claude: parse stream-json result usage via parseClaudeCliOutput. agy: record usage.source=unavailable (verified no usage surface).
items.userSees: Running lattice host_run --host codex --storyId B-70e9 --agentType reviewer --promptFile p.txt streams the host output live and ends with a stderr line like: "usage recorded: provider=openai input=10202 cacheRead=11008 output=85 (recordId llmuse_...)"
excludes: No change to gate semantics: usage rows stay gateEvidence=false diagnostics
No interception of interactive desktop sessions

happy.desc: Fake codex runner emitting a turn.completed usage event: host_run writes a sequence-1 estimate row and a sequence-2 provider-reported final superseding it, storyId/phase/agentType bound, mapping input=input_tokens-cached_input_tokens, cacheRead=cached_input_tokens, cacheCreation=null, output=output_tokens
Fake claude runner: stream-json result usage mapped via parseClaudeCliOutput with served model bound
Fake agy runner: unavailable final with provider name antigravity and explicit unavailableReason

edge.desc: Fake codex run ending in turn.failed with no usage event records an unavailable final, never a fabricated zero
LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0 leaves the run byte-identical: no rows, no dirs created
Host non-zero exit code propagates to the caller while rows still record

adversarial.desc: Prototype-polluted or wrong-typed usage payload must not fabricate counts: own-property projection keeps reads honest and the raw digest covers the ORIGINAL payload
A runner flooding stdout cannot exhaust memory: parse buffer is line-streamed and bounded while passthrough continues

items.context: review-runs.json rows carry reviewRunId like B-xxxx:RR-001 plus agent/lane; usage rows launched for a review run should carry the same identifiers so ledger rows and readManifest-bearing review passes can be joined. Coordinate with B-4a78 readManifest fields.

items.title: M1: Cover remaining lattice-initiated host spawns: autopilot repair step and host readiness probes write usage rows through the same seam
items.context: autopilot-executor runClaudeRepair spawns claude with no ledger seam; host-execution-readiness probes make real (tiny) LLM calls with no ledger rows. Wire both at their callers, keeping core/usage-ledger free of new cross-module imports.
items.userSees: After an autopilot repair or a host readiness probe, the usage report shows new rows with agentType "autopilot-repair" or "host-readiness-probe" instead of the runs being invisible

happy.desc: runClaudeRepair with ledger ON adds --output-format json, records preflight+final (agentType autopilot-repair), and the repair excerpt comes from the parsed envelope result
Readiness probe call sites record per-host preflight+final rows with agentType host-readiness-probe
cross_host_review codex leaf records preflight + unavailable final with argv unchanged

edge.desc: Ledger OFF keeps runClaudeRepair byte-identical to today (no --output-format json, no rows)
Probe failure paths (missing executable, auth, timeout) still write their preflight/unavailable rows without breaking the probe result

adversarial.desc: A ledger write failure must never fail the autopilot repair, the probe, or the cross-host review (seam never-throws contract exercised in smoke)

verificationEvidence.note: host-run-usage smoke asserts autopilot-repair rows + envelope excerpt with ON/OFF argv byte-identity, host-readiness-probe per-host rows, cross-host-review unavailable final, and seam-never-throws on corrupt ledger

items.title: M2: Add a read-only usage sweep command scanning ~/.codex/sessions rollouts and ~/.claude/projects transcripts since a cutoff and emitting a non-authoritative attribution report
items.context: Per session extract: token totals (codex: last token_count event_msg info.total_token_usage, cumulative semantics; claude: sum of assistant message.usage four fields), story-id mentions (B-hex4 regex), cwd, originator (desktop vs exec), timestamps. Output human table plus JSON, distinguishing lattice-launched sessions (correlatable to ledger rows) from foreign sessions labeled estimate/non-authoritative.
items.userSees: lattice usage_sweep --since 2026-07-01 prints a table headed "NON-AUTHORITATIVE ESTIMATE" with one row per host session: host, session, cwd, originator, tokens, story mentions; --json emits the same data machine-readably
excludes: No ledger backfill from swept sessions
No gate or lifecycle behavior reads sweep output

happy.desc: Fixture codex rollout: totals equal the LAST non-null cumulative info.total_token_usage; session_meta yields cwd/originator; story mentions extracted via B-hex4 regex
Fixture claude transcript: four-field usage summed with dedupe by requestId/message.id keeping last value; cwd and sessionId reported
--since cutoff excludes older files by mtime before reading

edge.desc: Rollout with only null-info token_count lines reports usage unknown, not zero
Split assistant events sharing message.id count once (dedupe fixture)
Empty or missing store dirs produce an empty report, not an error

adversarial.desc: Sweep makes zero writes (asserted by store dir mtime/content snapshot before/after in smoke)
Malformed JSONL lines are skipped without aborting the scan and are counted in a parse-error diagnostic
--out refuses paths outside the project root

Fixtures cover codex turn.completed and turn.failed, claude stream-json envelope, agy no-usage, codex rollout cumulative lines, claude transcript dedupe

items.title: M1: Enforce a per-dispatch token budget cap and a host-run concurrency cap at the choke point
items.context: User follow-up T2 (2026-07-10, task_3868995d): burn evidence includes five parallel codex exec reviewers consuming ~16M input tokens in about one minute, so the choke-point command must support (a) a per-dispatch hard budget ceiling (reuse/extend the existing fail-closed LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS preflight guard, decision.kind=blocked row on refusal) and (b) a concurrency cap on simultaneous lattice-initiated host runs (fail-closed refusal or bounded queue with a visible diagnostic), both diagnostics-honest in the ledger.
items.userSees: Exceeding the concurrency cap prints "host_run refused: 4 live host runs (cap 4)" with the live-run list and a nonzero exit; an over-budget run prints the existing hard-budget refusal and writes a blocked ledger row

happy.desc: Over-budget preflight estimate refuses before spawn via shouldBlockDispatch/recordBudgetBlock with decision.kind=blocked (reasonCode hard_budget_exceeded)
A 5th concurrent run under default cap 4 refuses fail-closed with exit != 0, prints the live-run list, and writes a blocked row with reasonCode concurrency_cap_exceeded

edge.desc: Stale slots (dead pid or old mtime) are reclaimed automatically so a crashed run never wedges the cap
LATTICE_HOST_RUN_MAX_CONCURRENT unset or invalid falls back to default 4; explicit higher value honored

adversarial.desc: Two runs racing for the last slot cannot both acquire it (atomic slot creation, e.g. exclusive-create semantics asserted in smoke)
Slot files cannot be used to inject content into ledger rows (slots carry pid/timestamps only)
